The '''Prophet''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] who lived around the time of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. He was known for making many specific predictions, all of which came true. The most controversial of these was his belief that the Aing-Tii [[Deity/Legends|deities]], [[Those Who Dwell Beyond the Veil]], would come to the [[Aing-Tii homeworld]] before his [[Death/Legends|death]]. However, around [[43 ABY]], soon after making this prophecy, the Prophet died, and there was still no sign of Those Who Dwell Beyond the Veil. This event threw the Aing-Tii into turmoil, splitting them into two factions.
